name: rules-rtdb-r14-priority-and-validate-scope
description: RTDB rules production verdicts for corpus scenario "r14-priority-and-validate-scope" (rtdb#71). Captured by deploy-observe-restore (RTDB has no server-side rules test API). getPriority() in both directions (a plain set carries no priority, so the priority-required node denies every write) and the scope of .validate (an ancestor .validate DOES govern a write to a node beneath it — production denies, the simulator allows).
